summary: Frontend-only testing of Ctrl/Cmd+K Command Palette feature. All 6 requested scenarios passed: (1) Ctrl+K opens palette with 4 admin quick actions, Esc/overlay/toggle close correctly. (2) sidebar-palette-hint opens palette. (3) Chats-section title match ('wombat') and Messages-section snippet match ('quokka') both open target chat; message-result Enter opens chat AND pre-fills chat-search-input='quokka' with count 1/2 and 3 <mark> highlights. (4) ArrowDown/ArrowUp move bg-white/10 highlighted row; typing 'zzzzqqqq' shows command-palette-empty. (5) Quick actions New Chat/Open Settings/Archived Chats/Admin Panel all functional; regular user (signed up via auth-toggle-mode) sees exactly 3 actions (no palette-item-action-admin). (6) Regression: Ctrl+F opens chat-search-bar only (not palette); Ctrl+K opens palette regardless (does not open in-chat search independently); sidebar-search-toggle still opens sidebar-search-input.

issues: When 'Archived Chats' quick action is invoked while Settings or User Management modal is already open, the sidebar view switches to Archived but stacked modals remain visible (see screenshot). Palette does not auto-close prior modal state — minor UX only, not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: CommandPalette.jsx: message-result key is `m-${r.chat_id}` — if the same chat_id appears multiple times across sections it is fine, but if backend ever returns multiple message rows per chat, React key uniqueness could break. Currently backend groups by chat so OK.

App.js Ctrl+K handler has no dependency array beyond []; correct. jumpToMessage sets chatSearchOpen=true and chatSearchTerm — highlighting confirmed working (3 <mark> for 2 message matches of 'quokka').
paletteActions rebuild memoized on isAdmin only; run() closures capture initial setSettingsOpen etc. via lexical scope — safe.
test_credentials: admin@openwebui.local / Admin@123; ephemeral signup users (deleted after test).
seed_data_creation: Seeded 2 chats via POST /api/chats/import (Wombat notes on hiking, Zoo animals chat with quokka content). Both deleted after test. Also created & deleted one regular user via signup.

Testids validated: command-palette, command-palette-overlay, command-palette-input, command-palette-empty, palette-item-action-{new-chat,settings,archived,admin}, palette-item-chat-<id>, palette-item-message-<id>, sidebar-palette-hint. Previously verified: auth/RBAC (it1), chat search + sidebar content search (it2). Existing 'Imported zebra chat' remains from iteration 2 seed data.
